throw-error-connector.title: Throw Error

parameters.name: Error Message

validator-connector-v2.title: Validator V2

parameters.description: Schema Draft version. Supported versions: v4, v6, v7, v2019-09, and v2020-12.

parameters.description: The JSON content to be validated.

parameters.description: The JSON Schema to be used as the basis for validating the JSON content.
